name: Lomita City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, September 07, 2021 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
VARIOUS TELECONFERENCE LOCATIONS
PURSUANT TO THE GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-08-21, THE COUNCIL AND THE PUBLIC MAY PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING VIA TELECONFERENCE. THE MEETING WILL BE HELD VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY AND NO PHYSICAL LOCATION FROM WHICH MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC MAY OBSERVE THE MEETING AND OFFER PUBLIC COMMENT WILL BE PROVIDED. ALL VOTES TAKEN DURING THIS MEETING WILL BE BY ROLL CALL VOTE, AND THE VOTE WILL BE PUBLICLY REPORTED.
The public may participate in the meeting via a computer or smart device by logging into ZOOM at the following link: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84885704635.
You may enter your name when prompted do so. If you wish to provide public comment at either the beginning of the meeting or for a particular item, you may either (a) contact the City Clerk's Office before the meeting and provide your name or (b) utilize the "raise hand" option located under the participant's name. Once you click on this option you will be in the rotation to make a public comment.
Please note, if you do not have the audio feature on your device you will need to call (669) 900-6833 and enter ZOOM Meeting ID: 848 8570 4635, then press pound (#). When prompted to enter the participation ID number press pound (#) again. To make a public comment enter "*9". The Clerk's office will be notified, and you will be announced to make a public comment.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution via the City of Lomita website or by contacting the Deputy City Clerk at l.abbott@lomitacity.com.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
This meeting will be conducted in compliance with CDC guidelines and applicable orders of the Los Angeles County Health Officer.
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Flag Salute
c)
Invocation – Council Member Waite
d)
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five-minute time limit per person has been established. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, requests for clarification or factual information, or placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-d be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Full Reading of Ordinances and that they be Read in Title Only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of July 20, 2021, and Special City Council Meeting of August 10, 2021
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.
Item 7b
c.
Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and file Warrants/Payroll Register.
Item 7c
d.
Resolution Accepting a Grant of Easement for Sidewalk Purposes at 24710 & 24712 Pennsylvania Avenue
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Adopt the attached Resolution accepting a Grants of Easement from the owners of the property where the easements are to be located (Emily Salas and Wilfredo Colitoy, owners of 24710 Pennsylvania Avenue, and Triada Builders Group, LLC, the owner of the property located 24712 Pennsylvania Avenue) for sidewalk purposes and finding the same exempt from CEQA, and 2) Authorize the City Manager to sign the Certificate of Acceptance and take any further actions necessary to accept the easement.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-31 A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING ACCEPTANCE OF THE SIDEWALK EASEMENT DEEDS AT 24710 & 24712 PENNSYLVANIA AVENUE FROM EMILY SALES, WILFREDO COLITOY, AND TRIADA BUILDERS GROUP, LLC TO THE CITY, AND FINDING SUCH ACQUISITION EXEMPT FROM CEQA
Item 7d
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO VOTING DELEGATE UPHOFF REGARDING LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES RESOLUTIONS
Presented by Lina Hernandez, Management Analyst
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Consider the two attached resolutions and determine the City’s positions in order for Voting Delegate Uphoff to cast his votes on behalf of the City during the League of California Cities 2021 Annual Conference’s Closing Luncheon and General Assembly Meeting, scheduled for 12:30 p.m. on Friday, September 24, 2021.
Item SCH 8
9.
CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION REGARDING LOS ANGELES HEALTH ORDER PROTOCOL FOR YOUTH SPORTS
Presented by Hunter Edwards, Recreation Supervisor
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Based on the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health’s Protocol for Organized Youth Sports, cancel all Moderate/High Risk youth sports as defined by LA County and direct staff to implement “Low Risk” youth sports or other alternative recreation activities.
Item SCH 9
10.
DISCUSS AND CONSIDER DESIGNATING TWO COUNCIL MEMBERS TO MEET WITH REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE DISTRICT ATTORNEY’S OFFICE AND REPORT BACK TO THE FULL CITY COUNCIL
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss and appoint two members of the City Council to meet with the Office of the District Attorney to discuss the District Attorney’s Special Directives and their impacts, and report back to the full City Council.
Item SCH 10
PUBLIC HEARINGS
11.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council is scheduled for Tuesday, September 21, 2021, at 6:00 p.m.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: September 2, 2021
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
